title: TASTE Test Score Samples
score_explanation: TASTE evaluates generated design images against human visual preferences across quality dimensions.

notes: Pairwise accuracy compares P(A wins B) >= 0.5 with the 5-rater human majority winner.
Vote-share correlation compares model P(A wins B) with the fraction of humans choosing A.
Top-1 accuracy aggregates pairwise probabilities within each 4-image prompt and compares the model-best image with the lowest human mean rank.

prompts.title: Preference sample
prompts.prompt: User Intent: Create an engaging editorial layout for a blog post or website article about travel experiences, combining a prominent lifestyle image with supporting imagery and a clear title and descriptive text. Description: The image displays a clean, modern layout featuring two photographs and a text block on a white background. On the left side, there is a large, vertically oriented photograph depicting three women in floral dresses walking on a cobblestone street in front of a peach-colored building with dark green shutters and a large wooden arched door. On the right side, there's a smaller, square-shaped photograph positioned above a text section. This photograph shows two cardboard boxes filled with vinyl records, with a hand reaching for one. Below the right photograph, a bold, all-caps title "TRIP TALES" is displayed, followed by a paragraph of Latin placeholder text. The overall arrangement uses a two-column structure, with the left image taking up the majority of the left column and the right image and text occupying the right column.
prompts.model_output_note: Per-image scores are aggregated from the pairwise model output: mean P(candidate wins) against the other candidates in this prompt.

prompts.title: Visual hierarchy sample
prompts.prompt: User Intent: Promote a chili cook-off event by providing all necessary details (date, time, location, prizes, entry fee, contact info) with an engaging, themed visual design that evokes a sense of fun and excitement. Aesthetics: The design adopts a playful, rustic, and energetic aesthetic, strongly hinting at a Western or Texan theme suitable for a chili cook-off. The dominant bright yellow background provides a cheerful and attention-grabbing canvas, effectively contrasting with the dark red/browns, greens, and oranges used for the text and illustrations. The typography establishes a clear hierarchy: the main "CHILI COOK-OFF" title uses a bold, decorative slab-serif font reminiscent of old Western signage, immediately drawing the eye. Supporting information like dates, times, and calls to action ("BRING HEAT!") use simpler, yet effective, sans-serif fonts, with "BRING HEAT!" being bolded for emphasis. The contact and prize details are in a readable serif font. The composition is well-balanced, with the dominant text elements in the upper half being visually anchored by the chili pepper illustrations and the '$5 ENTRY' starburst in the lower half. Elements are well-spaced, allowing for good readability and preventing clutter. The vibrant color palette, coupled with the thematic illustrations and bold typography, creates an inviting and festive overall feel.

prompts.title: Color harmony sample
prompts.prompt: User Intent: Create a social media ad or promotional graphic for a beauty product, featuring a positive user testimonial and star rating, highlighting key product benefits, and showcasing a diverse model interacting with the product. Aesthetics: The design exudes a modern, clean, and warm aesthetic. The typography employs a consistent sans-serif font throughout, with effective hierarchy established through varying font sizes, weights, and colors to guide the viewer's eye. The testimonial quote serves as a clear focal point. Spacing is generous, providing ample breathing room around text blocks and between the main visual elements, contributing to a sense of openness and ease. The composition achieves an asymmetrical balance; the photographic element on the left is visually weighted against the structured text and rating on the right. The use of rounded corners for the main content blocks and the organic abstract shapes softens the overall presentation. The color palette is harmonious, dominated by warm, earthy tones including light beige, peach, and various shades of brown and orange-brown, creating an inviting and gentle visual experience.

prompts.title: Mood & color tone sample
prompts.prompt: User Intent: Create a professional and modern promotional graphic for a bus charter company, highlighting its key services and contact information, suitable for digital marketing or print advertisements. Aesthetics: The design exhibits a modern, corporate, and professional aesthetic. The color palette is dominated by various shades of purple, ranging from a lighter, translucent violet in the upper background to a rich, dark plum at the bottom, creating a sophisticated gradient effect. White text provides high contrast and excellent readability against these dark backgrounds. The typography uses clean, sans-serif fonts throughout, with clear hierarchy established by varying font sizes and weights, guiding the viewer's eye from the main title to the smaller details. Spacing is well-managed, with ample negative space (dark purple areas) separating content blocks, preventing clutter, and ensuring each element has breathing room. The composition is dynamically asymmetrical; the strong textual block on the left is balanced by the visually engaging, angularly cropped bus image on the right. This unique shape adds a contemporary flair. The overall visual integration is cohesive, blending professionalism with an inviting appeal suitable for a transportation service.
